what: The live PreToolUse hook of the system this guard was ported into, scored on the same sets: each command sent as a Bash payload on stdin whose cwd is the bench's pinned root /work/repo (the process runs in an empty temp directory), judge off, no undo layer in that hook (an allow there is a plain allow). Deny or allow only. That hook acts only on the vendored guard's named-rule denies: a deny the guard gives because it could not read the command falls through to an allow there, by its own design.
